mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.real_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.role_code = #{role}

SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND u.is_deleted = 0
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY u.id DESC
